summary: Read a list of closed ranges already ordered by left ends. Those ranges neither cross nor touch. Then read one extra closed range and place it into the list. Join it with every existing range that overlaps it or meets it at an endpoint, using ends that cover every joined piece. Write the full list after the joins. Ranges that stay completely clear of the extra one remain as they were.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
